blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives on Wednesday passed on second reading a bill mandating the creation of a Metro Manila flood control master plan. In a voice vote, lawmakers approved House Bill No. 11602, which requires government agencies to map and harmonize urban drainage networks across city boundaries, mandating the integration of climate-resilient engineering and nature-based solutions along with strict audit mechanisms and public disclosures of project budgets. “This Master Plan shall harmonize and integrate the flood control and drainage network system master plans of all Metro Manila LGUs to achieve a region-wide, integrated, data-driven flood management system, ensuring […]...
